shared_elements: upright rectangular slab/pillar bearing relief carving
raised curved ridges suggesting limb- or animal-like forms
a rounded head-like or animal-head element near the top
vertical stacking of motifs on a tall narrow field
justification: Both are tall rectangular surfaces carved in relief with vertically stacked, rounded raised forms, and in each the topmost element reads as a head-like or animal-like protuberance, which is about as far as the correspondence goes. A depicts a legible multi-register scene of distinct creatures — a row of quadrupeds, a zigzag band, a profile carnivore, a crouching figure, a snake-like form and a long-necked bird — while B shows only two or three broad, undifferentiated ridges with no identifiable animals, no registers and no interaction between motifs.
